labels.rationale: Second attempt squashes other columns with no_wrap, the defect tracked in #2890; the first attempt's wrapping is documented.

body:
The second attempt looks like the column width problem described in #2890, where `no_wrap` lets a column squeeze other columns below their content width. Follow that issue for updates.

The first attempt wraps because `overflow` only truncates a column that has `no_wrap=True`, as the `no_wrap` option in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst describes.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
